pool.text: Nicholas, commissioned by Cossacks and designed by Vasily Stasov, was consecrated here.
The fortress located in Omsk was destroyed in this specific year.
The Dormition Cathedral, a five-domed Russian Revival structure, was consecrated here.
The Siberian Exposition of Agriculture and Industry marked a major developmental peak.
The Provisional All-Russian Government was established here, headed by Admiral Kolchak.
Bolshevik military forces successfully entered the city of Omsk.
Military industries including the OKMO tank-design bureau moved into Omsk.
Omsk Transmash officially declared bankruptcy during this specific year.
Governor Polezhayev resigned and Viktor Nazarov was appointed to the post.
The acting City Council of the sixth convocation was elected here.
